description: This file provides formatting and colorization utilities for terminal output, including functions to format keys, values, tags, separators, and to check if output should be rich or plain. It also re-exports a masking utility.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the terminal output should be colorized and formatted richly based on terminal capabilities and optional parameters.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified size using end padding.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string based on the theme.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string based on the theme.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional colorization.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Formats a tag string with theme-based colorization based on tag type and rich formatting.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if necessary.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
